synopsis: Celebrate your little Star Wars fan with this adorable, rhyming board book featuring some of your favorite characters from The Mandalorian. Part of the bestselling "You're My Little" series, You're My Little Grogu is an adorable board book to share with your littlest Star Wars fan! With chunky pages for little hands and die-cut shapes of characters from The Mandalorian, children will love the cute illustrations of Grogu, Ahsoka Tano, Luke Skywalker, Bo-Katan, and Din Djarin (AKA Mando). This endearing board book with rhyming text that celebrates a parent's love for their child is a wonderful read for traveling the Galaxy or any time.
title: You're My Little Grogu
